nodes.description: Against a background of prolonged repolarization and hypokalemia, triggered activity initiates polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, characteristically torsade de pointes, which may degenerate into cardiac arrest. The triggered activity itself has been measured directly: in superfused canine and guinea-pig Purkinje fibers, cesium at 3.6 to 4.0 mM with extracellular potassium reduced to 2 to 3 mM produced late early afterdepolarizations in 43% of fibers, and calcium loading accelerated their appearance. Cesium salts have been used deliberately for decades to induce exactly this arrhythmia in animal models of the long QT syndrome.
